units: Targ. Deut. VIII, 19 (O. ed. Berl. Ithpe.).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 137:5">Targ. Ps. CXXXVII, 5</cite>; a. e.—Y. Dem. IV, 24ᵃ [read:] <he>דילמא אַנְשִׁיתָה מתקנה</he> perhaps thou didst forget to prepare it (by giving tithes)? <cite ref="Ketubot 20a:9">Keth. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>ומַנְשֵׁי חר וכ׳</he> and one of the witnesses has forgotten (that he knows of the case).
<cite ref="Chullin 93b">Ḥull. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>אַנְשְׁיוּהָ לדר׳ וכ׳</he> they have forgotten R. Judah’s opinion.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 77">Gen. R. s. 77</cite> <he>דילמא אַנְשִׁינָן כלום</he> perhaps we forgot something (left behind).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:7">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> <he>אַנְשִׁית מאה</he> I forgot one hundred (of the fables); a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 2:6">Targ. Lam. II, 6</cite> (ed. Vien. <cite ref="N01301"><he>אינשי</he></cite>, corr. acc.); a. e.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 8:19">Targ. O. Deut. VIII, 19</cite> (v. supra); a. e.—Y. Shek. VII, 50ᶜ bot. <he>ואִינְשְׁתָהּ</he> and forgot to take it out; a. e.
